description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Elemental Machines develops IoT and software solutions for research, clinical, and quality-control laboratories. The Embedded Software Engineer will help develop IoT sensors, modules, gateways, and devices, working with hardware, firmware, applications software, and verification teams.
Embedded software engineer developing Python and C/C++ applications for IoT gateways and devices

Responsibilities:
• Write embedded software applications in Python and C/C++ that run on our IoT gateways and devices
• Collaborate with team members to develop system architecture for a robust, scalable platform
• Understand user requirements, contribute to the development of product requirements and participate in the entire product development life cycle
• Document your code, APIs and design decisions
• Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving feedback

Requirements:
• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
• 0–3 years of experience building software including internships, co-ops, research or personal projects
• Programming experience in Python, C/C++ is a plus
• Confident use of the Linux command line, Bash scripting and Git
• Working knowledge of containerization tools such as Docker
• A habit of writing clean, testable code and a willingness to ask questions and learn quickly
• Familiarity with software testing methodologies and design patterns
• Understanding of application design: state machines, event-driven architecture

Preferred:
• Understanding of concurrency on constrained devices: threads or tasks, queues, mutexes and avoiding race conditions
• Exposure to application-level communication such as TCP/IP, MQTT, BLE/Wi-Fi or serial command protocols
• Experience with embedded development, including microcontroller platforms such as Arduino or ESP32, and RTOS concepts
• Experience interacting with hardware / low-level protocols (e.g. I2C, UART, Modbus, CAN)
• Debugging on real hardware with JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers
• Experience with device fleet management platforms
• Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP
